# Code of Conduct

We want this project to stay welcoming, constructive, and easy to collaborate on.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and assume good intent.
- Keep feedback focused on the code and the product.
- Help the conversation stay specific, actionable, and kind.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, or personal attacks.
- Deliberate disruption or repeated bad-faith behavior.
- Sharing private or sensitive information without permission.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, hide, or close content that violates this policy and may limit participation when needed.
